statement: The prevalence of previous child deaths among SUID cases is higher compared to live births from PRAMS Phase 8.
rationale: This study compares the proportion of mothers with previous child deaths between SUID cases and live births, using proxy variables for previous child deaths in PRAMS data.
prior_art: None in the inputs. The closest claims focus on maternal smoking, prematurity, and environmental factors but do not investigate previous family infant mortality as a risk factor for SUID.
